title.zh: 商業洞察｜半導體人才市場與 HR 實務觀察｜HiReKing
title.en: Insights | Semiconductor Talent Market and HR Practice | HiReKing

desc.zh: HiReKing 從招募現場整理的觀察：半導體人才市場動態、薪酬結構、競業條款實務與台灣科技業的 HR 議題。
desc.en: Observations from the hiring floor: the semiconductor talent market, pay structures, non-compete practice and HR issues facing Taiwan's technology sector.

sub.zh: 我們每週接觸數十位半導體與科技業人選，聽到的是市場最前緣的真實聲音。這裡整理成對企業與人選都用得上的內容。
sub.en: We speak with dozens of semiconductor and technology candidates every week and hear the market before it shows up in any report. These notes turn that into something both employers and candidates can use.

body.zh: 內容規劃中，文章上線後會替換為實際連結。若你有特別想看的題目，歡迎告訴我們。
body.en: In production — these cards will link to the articles once published. If there is a topic you want covered, tell us.

title.zh: 競業禁止條款到底擋不擋得住？實務上的四個判斷點
title.en: Do non-compete clauses actually hold? Four practical tests

body.zh: 從補償措施、限制期間、地域範圍到職務關聯性，看台灣實務上競業條款的有效性與雙方風險。
body.en: Compensation, duration, geographic scope and role relevance — how enforceable non-competes really are in Taiwan, and the risk on both sides.

title.zh: 股票綁定期怎麼算進 offer？半導體挖角的補償缺口計算
title.en: Pricing unvested equity into an offer

body.zh: 人選手上還沒到期的股票是留任的真正原因。這篇說明怎麼估算補償缺口，以及企業常見的三種處理方式。
body.en: Unvested equity is the real reason people stay. How to quantify the gap, and the three ways employers usually bridge it.

title.zh: 先進封裝人才荒：這個缺口三年內補得起來嗎
title.en: The advanced packaging talent gap: can it close in three years?

body.zh: 從學界培育速度、跨領域轉入的可行性與國際競爭三個面向，看這個職能的供給結構。
body.en: Academic pipeline, feasibility of cross-domain transfers, and international competition — a look at the supply structure for this function.

title.zh: 面試流程拉太長，你正在把人選送給對手
title.en: A slow interview process is a gift to your competitors

body.zh: 在科技業，決策速度本身就是競爭條件。這篇談怎麼在不降低標準的前提下把流程壓短。
body.en: In technology, decision speed is itself a competitive term. How to shorten the process without lowering the bar.

title.zh: 台商到東南亞設廠，人資最常踩的五個坑
title.en: Five HR mistakes Taiwanese manufacturers make in Southeast Asia

body.zh: 當地薪資結構、外派配套、工會與勞資關係，以及把台灣制度直接複製過去的代價。
body.en: Local pay structures, expatriate packages, unions and labour relations — and what it costs to copy the Taiwanese playbook wholesale.

title.zh: 薪資帶寬怎麼訂，才不會招不到又內部不公
title.en: Setting salary bands that work outside and inside

body.zh: 從市場對標到內部相對公平，一份可以直接用的職級與薪酬設計檢查表。
body.en: From market benchmarking to internal equity — a checklist you can use as it stands.

title.en: Want to talk through one of these?

body.zh: 文章還沒寫完，但顧問現在就能跟你談。這些題目我們每天都在處理。
body.en: The articles are still being written, but the consultants can talk today. We work on these questions daily.
